sections.label: Temasek returns and comparisons
sections.summary: Question asks reasons for Temasek's worst reported returns since 2016 and how its results compare with other sovereign wealth funds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (a) what are the main reasons for Temasek Holdings’ worst reported returns since 2016, where the net value of its portfolio shrunk by $21 billion from 2022 to 2023; and (b) how do Temasek Holdings’ recent results compare against other sovereign wealth funds such as Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund.

sections.label: Temasek unlisted asset returns
sections.summary: Temasek's unlisted assets registered 14.4% IRR over 20 years and over 10% annually over the last decade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As for returns on Temasek's unlisted assets, these have registered an Internal Rate of Return (IRR) of 14.4% in the past 20 years, compared to 8% for its listed assets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Over the last decade, Temasek's unlisted portfolio has also generated IRR of over 10% per annum, higher than its listed portfolio.

sections.label: Temasek FY2023 performance
sections.summary: Temasek's performance for the financial year ending 31 March 2023 was largely driven by mark-to-market losses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: With regard to Temasek's performance for the latest Financial Year ending 31 March 2023, this was largely driven by mark-to-market losses as global investments saw a reversal of gains from the high valuations in the last two years.

sections.label: Temasek unlisted IRR benchmarks
sections.summary: The reply repeats that Temasek's unlisted assets registered 14.4% IRR over 20 years and over 10% annually over the last decade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I think Ms Mariam asked about the benchmarks and comparisons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I shared in my main reply, and let me just refer to that again, that if we look at the rate of return, the IRR, for Temasek's unlisted assets, these have registered an IRR of 14.4% in the past 20 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If you look at it, the unlisted portfolio has also generated an IRR of over 10% per annum over the last decade.

sections.label: Clarification on Temasek loss
sections.summary: A member asks for clarification, saying Temasek reported a $7.3 billion loss while the portfolio shrunk by $21 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Senior Minister of State one clarification?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I am confused because Temasek reported a loss of $7.3 billion and you said the portfolio shrunk by $21 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: If the portfolio shrunk by $21 billion, then rightfully, that should be reported as a loss as well.
